**Johor Bahru, 13 October 2026** – KPJ Healthcare Berhad (“KPJ Healthcare” or “the Group”), Malaysia’s first private Academic Health System, has introduced AI-assisted colonoscopy at Johor Specialist Hospital (“JSH”) in Johor Bahru to support the early detection of colorectal cancer.

As Malaysia’s first private healthcare provider to establish an Academic Health System, the KPJ Health System (KPJHS) integrates practice, education, research and innovation to drive clinical excellence and patient experience. Beyond hospitals, KPJ Healthcare operates Klinik Waqaf An-Nur (KWAN) clinics, dialysis centres and mobile clinics nationwide, and offers more than 40 academic programmes at KPJ Healthcare University (KPJU). KPJ Healthcare has been a constituent of the Bursa Malaysia FTSE4Good Index since 2016.
